items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I decided Professor Perron, well, he's a cousin of mine. Well, he's a cousin. Cousin of mine.

ctx.x: 1726 Northville, right? Northville. I see. What kind of music did you hear when you were young?

Oh, nothing else but Dixieland music. Did your father play any instrument? I know your uncle was a violin player. You liked them low about... My uncle was a violin player. My uncle was a violin player. Well, my daddy was a... He started trumpet. But he never did violin. I know. I know. Anyone else in the family that played? Of course, we know your brother. Oh, yeah. I have a wonderful brother, Bonnie Biggoin. He's the top musician. Were there any other members of the family, any other brothers or sister that…
They had Walter Deku on piano. Emile Biggoin on violin. And they had Bill Matthews was playing drum.
